name: Jan
description: Desktop AI assistant that downloads and runs open models locally, positioned as a private ChatGPT replacement.
whatItDoes: Lets users chat with models such as Llama, Gemma and Qwen pulled from Hugging Face, entirely on their own machine. Installers are provided for macOS, Windows and Linux.
howItWorks: A Tauri desktop application written in Rust and TypeScript manages local model downloads and inference. Users normally install a released build; building from source needs Node.js, Yarn, Make and Rust.

requirements.name: Memory for local models
requirements.description: Roughly 8GB RAM for 3B models, 16GB for 7B, 32GB for 13B on macOS; GPU support on Windows and Linux

models: Local open models from Hugging Face
